_readme: HMP Bikes LA store P&L parameters (Task 3 v1, 2026-09-08). Convention copied from market_size_params.json: lo = CONSERVATIVE scenario value (worse for HMP: lower demand / price, higher cost), base = Base, hi = AGGRESSIVE (better for HMP). Scenarios take every parameter at its corner, so Conservative/Aggressive are joint corners, not P10/P90. tag: FACT (verifiable public or HMP-stated), ESTIMATE (derived from several sources, range given), ASSUMPTION (no direct evidence; replace with HMP data). ask_hmp: the assumptions_template.csv id (R/C/S rows) whose HMP figure should replace the value. Parameters with a 'curve' are month->value paths; lo/base/hi is a multiplier on the whole curve (piecewise-linear from 0 at month 0, flat after the last point). Names reuse la-hub/model/assumptions_template.csv ids where one exists. Tier mapping: 'ebike' family = template tiers A/B (INNO-A Pro, LIVA 7 Class 2 e-bikes; Lightning 3000 mopeds); 'moto' family = tier D (FLASH 75 mph, Lightning MK.II 56 mph; DOT motorcycles, M1). Configurations live in _configs. Sources: la-hub/model/store_pnl_notes.md.

ceres_8000.label: 768 Ceres Ave, 8,443 sf, $8,000/mo
ceres_8000.note: FACT (founder): asking now $8,000 (was $10,000). Listing mirrors show $1.20/sf Full Service (~$10,132) and $19.20/sf/yr (~$13,509); lease type of the $8,000 figure unknown -> rent_nnn_psf_month applies. 400A 3-phase, sprinklered, yard gate (LoopNet snippet).

corridor_7500.label: Pico/Olympic corridor unit, ~6,300 sf, $7,500/mo avg
corridor_7500.note: ESTIMATE: 18th St (Grand-Olive) 7,644 sf $6,900 (anonymous Craigslist, unverified) to 1738 Cordova 5,000 sf ~$9,900 NNN (research/04-location-coverage.md s.5). Block-level robbery/assault comparable to Ceres, half-mile lower -> security 0.8x (ASSUMPTION).

_sf_equivalent_overrides._note: What-if: SF's ~40 units/month all-SKU pace (>1,000 in ~25 months), ~100 whole-bike rentals and 300+ battery subscribers transplanted onto the LA cost base. Founder's mix parameter 60% e-bike/moped / 40% FLASH-MK.II applied. Not a forecast.

retail_moto_units_scale.note: Commuter / enthusiast / car-replacement buyers across the LA metro, NOT bounded by the rider SOM. Anchor: SF ~40 units/month all-SKU with founder on site, walk-in and a seeded community; FLASH launched Jul 2026 with national press. Base = ~15/month by month 24 (~1/3 of SF pace for this family), lo x0.5, hi x1.6. This is the single most important assumption in the model; replace with SF's monthly FLASH/MK.II sales by ZIP.

retail_ebike_units_scale.unit: units/month (INNO / LIVA / Lightning 3000 retail, non-rider buyers)
retail_ebike_units_scale.note: Students, commuters, non-courier buyers. Rider (courier) purchases are modelled separately from the SOM path.

rider_customers_scale.note: SOM from la-hub/model/market_size.py (research/03-market-size.md): month 12 = 40 (credible 30-65), month 24 = 72 bottom-up / 105 SF-anchored (credible 50-150). Month 36 extrapolated (ASSUMPTION). lo x0.65 -> 26/47/65; hi x2.0 -> 80/144/200. This is the rider-side ceiling for rentals, battery subs and rider vehicle purchases.

rider_churn_monthly.unit: share of active rider customers lost per month
rider_churn_monthly.note: Drives gross adds (CAC) and replacement sales. No SF figure yet.

rider_share_rental.unit: share of active rider customers on whole-bike rental
rider_share_rental.note: SF: ~100 rentals of ~400 recurring-paying customers = 0.25; LA early years more rental-heavy (cash-constrained, no trust). lo = more renters = more fleet capital per customer.

rider_share_battery_sub.unit: share of active rider customers on battery subscription (owners)
rider_share_battery_sub.note: SF: 300+ of ~400 recurring = 0.75, but assumption register A01/E1: attach falls to 5-15% beyond ~1.5 mi; Ceres is 3-6 mi from Koreatown/Westlake/USC. Remainder = owners without subscription.

rider_buyer_moto_share.unit: share of rider vehicle purchases that are FLASH/MK.II
rider_buyer_moto_share.note: Couriers mostly buy Class 2 / moped tier (no M1 needed; SF fleet is INNO-based per Gazetteer 2026-04). M1 holders are a minority of LA couriers (register A11).

rental_to_purchase_conversion_la.unit: share of active renters buying a vehicle each month
rental_to_purchase_conversion_la.note: SF rent-to-own funnel (~$380/mo Inno package per Gazetteer). LA assumed slower (register A16).

existing_la_installed_base.unit: HMP vehicles already in LA County at opening (online/Davis sales)

dealers_active_scale.unit: active SoCal dealers (Santa Barbara, San Diego, OC) served from LA
dealers_active_scale.note: No dealers exist yet. Wholesale revenue booked through the LA store at dealer price; intercompany treatment with Davis HQ is ASK HMP.

dealer_units_per_dealer_month.note: Small powersports dealers typically move a few units of a new brand per month.

dealer_moto_share.unit: share of dealer units that are FLASH/MK.II

dealer_discount_b2b.note: Powersports dealer margins commonly 10-25% of MSRP. HMP wholesale price = ASP x (1 - discount).

regional_van_start_month.note: Van bought when the first dealer signs.

van_capex_onetime.note: Used cargo van + racking/tie-downs + wrap. hi = older van or lease.

van_running_monthly.note: Fuel, commercial auto insurance, maintenance, parking for ~1,000 mi/month of regional service runs.

price_sale_tier_D_moto.unit: USD blended realized ASP, FLASH + MK.II
price_sale_tier_D_moto.note: FACT list prices (founder brief / hmpbikes.com): FLASH $4,799 single / $5,799 dual, +$200 charger; MK.II $3,999. Blend assumes ~60% FLASH (70% single, 50% charger attach) / 40% MK.II ~ $4,700 list; base $4,600 after promos; lo = heavier discounting.

price_sale_tier_A_ebike.unit: USD blended realized ASP, e-bike/moped family
price_sale_tier_A_ebike.note: FACT list: INNO-A Pro $2,599, LIVA 7 $1,599, Lightning 3000 $2,999 / 3000 Plus $3,599, Delivery Combo $2,499 (hmpbikes.com 2026-09).

fob_cost_moto.unit: USD FOB China per FLASH/MK.II blended
fob_cost_moto.note: No public data. Assumed ~43% of blended ASP before duty/freight (3.3 kWh single / 6.6 kWh dual packs are the main cost; MK.II lighter). Implies ~32% gross margin at the 37.5% tariff, inside the 35-45% the founder's plan implies only at <=25% tariff. Replace with HMP's actual FOB.

fob_cost_ebike.unit: USD FOB China per e-bike/moped blended
fob_cost_ebike.note: Assumed ~40% of blended ASP; INNO-A Pro / LIVA 7 48V packs, Lightning 3000 30-45Ah.

freight_per_unit_moto.unit: USD per unit, ocean + drayage + port fees to LA
freight_per_unit_moto.note: Crated motorcycle ~1.2 CBM; LA/LB port is the destination so no inland leg.

tariff_rate_moto.unit: ad valorem on FOB, HTS 8711.60.0090 from China
tariff_rate_moto.note: FACT: MFN Free; Section 301 List 2 (9903.88.02) +25% (CBP ruling NY N344662, 2024-12-20). FACT: IEEPA fentanyl/reciprocal layers struck down by SCOTUS 2026-02-20; Section 122 10% surcharge ran 2026-02-24 to 2026-07-24 and expired (Thomson Reuters 2026-07-07; CIT held it invalid 2026-05-07, on appeal). ESTIMATE: replacement country-differentiated Section 301 action (announced 2026-06-02, 10%/12.5% tiers) places China at 12.5% per secondary sources (tariffstool.com 2026-07-31, movargo.com) -> base 25% + 12.5% = 37.5%. hi = 25% if the new tier is struck down/excluded. The 100% Section 301 EV rate applies to HTS 8703 passenger EVs, not 8711.60, so 100% is a policy-shock case (see tariff table), not a scenario value. Country of origin China is ASSUMPTION - confirm with HMP/customs broker.

tariff_rate_ebike.unit: ad valorem on FOB, HTS 8711.60.0050 e-bikes from China
tariff_rate_ebike.note: Same stack as moto. hi = 12.5% if the Section 301 e-bike exclusion (extended to 2026-11-10 per search summary, unverified for this subheading) applies.

warranty_reserve_rate.unit: share of ASP reserved for warranty/free service
warranty_reserve_rate.note: MK.II page: 1 yr / 10,000 mi warranty; site banner claims 3-year. Ask HMP for SF claim rate.

parts_accessory_attach_per_sale.note: Locks ($49.95), racks, bags, phone mounts, second battery ($599) on some sales.

sales_commission_per_unit.note: Sales incentive on top of hourly pay.

affirm_share_of_retail.unit: share of retail vehicle revenue financed via Affirm/BNPL
affirm_share_of_retail.note: $4-5k tickets to cash-constrained buyers; hmpbikes.com advertises financing.

affirm_mdr.unit: merchant discount rate on financed sales
affirm_mdr.note: Affirm merchant fees are individually negotiated; typical 2-8%, commonly ~5-6% incl. 0% APR promos (Affirm business hub; chargeflow.io 2026).

card_fee_per_txn.note: Rentals billed weekly (4.33 txn/month), subscriptions monthly, sales once.

rental_weekly_tier_A.note: Founder range $50-80. Ceiling: Whizz LA $139-169/mo all-in (~$35-40/wk), Zoomo from $39/wk (register A02). SF rate card is an image on 415ebike.com/pages/rental - ask for it.

rental_fleet_moped_share.unit: share of rental fleet in the licensed moped tier
rental_fleet_moped_share.note: CVC 14608 / M1 check limits the licensed-tier renter pool (register A11/A13).

rental_realized_price_factor.note: Monthly-billing discount, free first week, promos. SF realized price net of discounts is ASK HMP.

rental_utilization_target.unit: rented units / owned units (fleet sized to this)
rental_utilization_target.note: Register A16: realistic 60-75% vs 85-90% assumed; units in repair, reconditioning, impound, idle.

initial_rental_fleet_size.note: lo = larger idle fleet is worse; fleet then grows with demand / utilization target.

rental_moped_cost_multiplier.unit: moped-tier landed cost vs e-bike family landed cost

vehicle_life_months_rental.note: Register A18: 36-month straight line to 20-30% residual is itself an assumption for 10 hr/day delivery use.

vehicle_residual_ratio.unit: residual / landed cost at end of life

maintenance_per_rental_vehicle_month.unit: USD parts + outside labor per owned unit-month
maintenance_per_rental_vehicle_month.note: Tyres, brakes, crash repair; in-house labor is in staff cost.

gps_per_vehicle.unit: USD per owned unit-month (tracker + immobilizer subscription)
gps_per_vehicle.note: Fleet GPS $8.95-45/vehicle/month (Spytec/One Step GPS 2026); Monimoto ~$3.50/mo; hardware amortized.

insurance_rental_fleet_per_ebike_month.unit: USD per owned e-bike-month (property/theft rider on BOP)
insurance_rental_fleet_per_ebike_month.note: Small rental fleets: $1,200-3,100/yr for 15-25 bikes (lendcontrol.com 2026) = $5-11/bike/month; delivery use and LA likely higher.

tier_insurance_per_vehicle_month.unit: USD per owned moped-month, auto liability for a registered vehicle rented for delivery
tier_insurance_per_vehicle_month.note: Register A15: specialty programs $60-200/vehicle/month or declined for delivery use (Revel exit). CA minimum 30/60/15 since 2025.

theft_loss_rate_rental_fleet_annual.unit: share of fleet replacement value lost per year, net of recoveries and deposits
theft_loss_rate_rental_fleet_annual.note: Register A15: double-digit annual loss reported by delivery-rental operators in high-theft US cities; Whizz claims <1% (marketing); LA motorized-device thefts +22% in 2024 (Crosstown/LAPD).

bad_debt_rate_rental_revenue.note: No-credit-check weekly renters: chargebacks, unpaid final weeks.

battery_sub_monthly_price.note: Founder range $60-100. The public $150 / $500 / $25-per-month figures on 415ebike.com are theft-retrieval / loss / optional-insurance terms, not the subscription price (unverified as a price). Competitors bundle swaps into rental (Whizz) or price ~$49/mo (Whizz NY swap) - register A02.

batteries_per_subscriber.unit: packs in float per subscriber (in use + charging + spare)

battery_cost.note: Retail 48V 24Ah = $599 (hmpbikes.com); moped 74V 45Ah (3.3 kWh) retail unknown. Assumes ~50% of retail landed incl. tariff.

battery_life_months_delivery_use.note: Register A17: consumer-guide lifetimes overstate delivery-cycle life (12-16 swaps/month).

kwh_per_swap.unit: kWh charged per swap incl. losses
kwh_per_swap.note: 48V 24Ah = 1.15 kWh; 74V 45Ah = 3.3 kWh; blended toward e-bike packs.

rental_fleet_kwh_per_unit_month.unit: kWh/owned rental unit-month charged at the store
rental_fleet_kwh_per_unit_month.note: Renters mostly home-charge; store tops up returns and swaps.

swap_station_capex_onetime.unit: USD cabinets, racks, chargers (excl. fire-code work)

repair_revenue_per_active_customer_month.unit: USD paid service + parts per vehicle in installed base per month
repair_revenue_per_active_customer_month.note: Installed base = existing LA vehicles + vehicles sold by the store (retail + rider); rentals get free service. Warranty work is in warranty_reserve_rate.

repair_gross_margin.unit: ratio (parts at cost; labor in staff line)

service_walkin_monthly_scale.note: Couriers on other brands; DTLA has few e-moped repair shops.

wage_manager_hourly.note: ~$62k/yr base; works the floor and sells.

wage_technician_hourly.note: LA motorcycle / e-bike technician; verify against BLS OES 49-3052 LA MSA.

wage_frontdesk_hourly.note: FACT floor: City of LA minimum wage $18.42/hr from 2026-07-01 (wagesla.lacity.gov memo 2026-01-30).

payroll_load.note: FICA 7.65%, CA UI/ETT/SDI ~3%, workers comp (mechanic class ~6-10%), small benefits stipend.

fte_sales_ops.note: 7-day cover needs the manager on the floor; a second front-desk FTE would add ~$4.6k/month.

rent_escalation_annual.note: LA industrial rents fell 32% over 36 months (CBRE Q2 2026); 3% fixed bumps are standard in LOIs.

rent_nnn_psf_month.unit: USD/sf/month taxes + insurance + CAM on top of base rent
rent_nnn_psf_month.note: hi = Full Service as two Ceres listing mirrors state; lo = full NNN pass-through $0.20-0.40/sf (register A19).

security_deposit_months.unit: months of rent held by landlord (cash, returned after term)

utilities_monthly.unit: USD/month lighting, HVAC, water, internet (charging electricity computed separately)

insurance_gl_property_monthly.unit: USD/month garage liability + garagekeepers + property + product liability (dealer)
insurance_gl_property_monthly.note: No public premium found; small powersports dealer packages typically $15-35k/yr; lithium inventory at a Skid-Row-adjacent address may add protective conditions (register A15).

security_monthly.note: Remote video monitoring $50-150/camera/month; alarm monitoring from ~$10-30 (Guardian Integrated 2026).

security_monthly_guard.unit: USD/month evening guard if insurer requires it
security_monthly_guard.note: Unarmed guard $25-40/hr in LA (GNS Guard 2026); 4 hrs x 30 days x $35 = $4,200. Base assumes cameras + gate suffice.

marketing_monthly.unit: USD/month test rides, events, digital, flyers

cac_per_rider.unit: USD per gross new rider customer (promos, referral bounties, bilingual outreach)
cac_per_rider.note: Register A03: LA first-6-month CAC $150-400 vs SF ~$0-50 organic.

launch_marketing_onetime.unit: USD month 1 (opening events, pop-ups, waitlist ads)

software_gna_monthly.unit: USD/month POS, telematics platform, accounting, phone, legal, bank

permits_taxes_monthly.unit: USD/month LA business tax, dealer renewals, plates
permits_taxes_monthly.note: CA dealer renewal $125 + plates $94 each + bond; LA gross-receipts tax.

inventory_days.unit: days of sales held on the floor (min floor stock applies)

inventory_carrying_rate_annual.unit: ratio of floor inventory landed value per year (cost of capital, insurance, obsolescence)

security_onetime.unit: USD cameras, alarm, gate motor/bollards, safe

fire_code_compliance_onetime.unit: USD charging circuits, detection, LAFD permit engineering (2025 CFC Sec. 320/322)
fire_code_compliance_onetime.note: Register A21: $40-150k if aspirating detection / dedicated circuits / sprinkler work required; hi = simple circuits only. Ceres has 400A 3-phase and sprinklers (LoopNet).

dmv_dealer_license_onetime.unit: USD CA DMV dealer license setup
dmv_dealer_license_onetime.note: Motorcycle dealer bond $10,000 (premium ~$100-500/yr), application ~$175, New Motor Vehicle Board fee $425/location, pre-licensing course, plates $94 each, signage/consultant (dmv.ca.gov; suretybonds.com 2026). Needed to retail FLASH/MK.II (DOT motorcycles); Class 2 e-bikes need no dealer license.

fixtures_signage_onetime.unit: USD signage, display, tools, lift, workbench

buildout_amortization_months.unit: months (depreciation of one-time buildout for operating profit)

lease_term_months.note: Model horizon = 36 months; lease exposure beyond that is not modelled.

logistics_saving_monthly.note: Founder (2026-09-08): containers land at Long Beach; drayage to SF ~$4,000 vs ~$1,000 to an LA warehouse, i.e. ~$3,000 saved per container, ~$36k/yr at one container/month. Base 0 keeps the store P&L standalone; set 3000 to credit the LA warehouse with the company-wide saving. Net saving is lower if SF still needs stock trucked up from LA (LTL LA->SF ~$150-250/unit, ASSUMPTION) or if fewer than 12 containers/yr arrive.
